movies.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
movies.tagline: Welcome to the Second Quarter Quell.
movies.synopsis: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自苏珊·柯林斯的同名小说。故事发生在《饥饿游戏》事件发生前24年，讲述第50届饥饿游戏（第二次四分区叛乱纪念赛）抽签日当天，年轻的黑密斯·阿伯纳西被选中参赛的故事。

movies.title: You Can See Everything
movies.synopsis: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 在被判入狱前的34天，臭名昭著的硅谷创始人伊丽莎白·霍姆斯邀请了一支持怀疑态度的摄制组记录她的一举一动。起初这是一部关于神秘罪犯的私密肖像，却演变成一场持续3年、坠入深渊的迷幻之旅。

movies.title: Wicker
movies.countryOrigin: United Kingdom / United States of America
movies.synopsis: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 海边小镇里有一个身上散发臭味的打渔女，饱受狭隘的邻居嘲讽，而她为自己找了个柳条做成的丈夫。这段离经叛道的爱情在保守的小镇里引起了怒火、嫉妒和轩然大波。

movies.title: Ebenezer
movies.countryOrigin: United States of America / United Kingdom
movies.tagline: Before he was Scrooge, he was…
movies.synopsis: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自查尔斯·狄更斯小说《圣诞颂歌》。一位年迈的吝啬商人遭遇故友亡灵及圣诞过去、现在与未来的幽灵造访，被迫直面自己的过往，并踏上一段寻求幸福与救赎的超自然旅程。

movies.title: Wild Horse Nine
movies.countryOrigin: United Kingdom / United States of America
movies.tagline: Sometimes you've got to do a terrible thing for the greater good.
movies.synopsis: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 1973年智利，性格迥异的CIA特工克里斯和李被局长从圣地亚哥派往复活节岛，这对搭档将执行一项考验彼此信任和忠诚的任务。

movies.title: Bad Apples
movies.countryOrigin: United Kingdom / United States of America
movies.synopsis: A struggling primary school teacher is forced to take drastic action because of a foul-mouthed, violent student, and uncovers how her community will turn a blind eye to the most outrageous events to preserve harmony and their sense of safety.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 小学老师玛利亚尽力管教一班10岁孩子，却被一名不守规矩的学生拖累。随着自身事业承压、该生行为愈发恶劣，她做出错误决定，意外将这名学生带回并锁在家中。玛利亚本想反悔，可班级情况逐渐好转，同事和家长都为此欣喜，她就此陷入两难困境。

movies.title: Primetime
movies.tagline: Are you ready to make television history?
movies.synopsis: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 聚焦电视主持人克里斯·汉森与他推出的一档真人秀节目“猎捕恋童癖”，该节目利用人员在网络上伪装成未成年人，引诱恋童癖进入摄影棚，并将其逮捕。

movies.title: Focker-in-Law
movies.synopsis: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, aims to marry Olivia, a strong-willed former hostage negotiator who appears to be his complete mismatch. To Greg's shock, stepdad Jack Byrnes takes a liking to Olivia, and her unprecedented rise into his Circle of Trust sparks chaos in the family before Jack's 80th birthday party.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 格雷格·福克和帕姆·伯恩斯的儿子亨利已经长大成人，并决定与一位看似与他完全不合拍的女性奥利维亚·琼斯结婚。奥利维亚曾是一名FBI人质谈判专家。她自信地表示，这份职业经历让她完全有能力将亨利从被“情感绑架”的状态中“解救”出来。奥利维亚这种直率强势的性格让格雷格感到不安和不满。然而，前CIA特工杰克·伯恩斯——那位以严苛考验女婿闻名的岳父却因此对奥利维亚刮目相看，甚至欣赏她，并想邀请她加入家族的“信任圈”。

movies.title: Everest: The Other Side
movies.synopsis: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest—the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth—something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 真实记录登山滑雪运动员吉姆·莫里森于2025年10月成功沿珠穆朗玛峰北坡霍恩拜因雪沟登顶，并成为全球首位在该危险路线完成滑雪速降的历史性壮举。

movies.title: Traces of Justice
movies.tagline: Four true crimes that shocked China.
movies.synopsis: The film follows criminal police officer Cui Xun over half a century of investigative work. Alongside his colleagues, he solved numerous major cases while staying true to his original aspiration of 'serving the people.' This legendary detective not only witnessed the evolution of China's public security system but also stood as a living testament to the rise of New China.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 凡是经过，皆有痕迹。刑事技术警察崔寻走过半个多世纪，与同事屡破大案，这位秉承着“为人民服务”初心的神探，不仅见证了公安事业的发展，更见证了新中国的崛起。

movies.title: Wildwood
movies.tagline: How far would you go for those you love?
movies.synopsis: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 普鲁和同班同学柯蒂斯误入一片禁忌魔法森林，林中遍布魔法生灵、忠心伙伴与强大劲敌。二人踏上一场凶险万分的营救之旅，要从神秘女子亚历山德拉统领的鸦群手中，救出被掳走的婴儿弟弟麦克。

movies.title: How to Rob a Bank
movies.synopsis: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 别人抢劫东躲西藏，他们直播全网教学，别人抢劫只想暴富，他们只为分给需要的人！当规则不再公平，欲望横流的金钱游戏，谁才是真的掠夺者？.

movies.title: Fatherland
movies.synopsis: Currently screening in cinemas. Select a session time for auditorium details and official venue booking.

movies.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
movies.tagline: There is no third time. Everything ends here.
movies.synopsis: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 人类的罪与罚。已经，没法归零。战争将日本粉碎至“零”，哥斯拉的袭击更将它推至“负”的绝境。时间来到两年后，人民历尽痛苦磨难仍坚持复苏的步伐，看似终于可以回归正常生活……然而此时，巨兽再次袭来。它彻底摧毁这份希望，将人类推向新的绝望深渊！

movies.title: Resident Evil
movies.synopsis: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 奉命奔赴浣熊市的医疗速递员布莱恩，意外深陷全城失控的病毒浩劫。浣熊市彻底沦陷，异变怪物横行肆虐、嗜血猎捕，身陷末日绝境的他，能否在这场惊魂噩梦中突围求生，搏出一线生机？.

movies.title: Ramayana: Part 1
movies.synopsis: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自印度古代史诗《罗摩衍那》。魔王罗波那作恶多端，欲用武力一统三界。毗湿奴神化身罗摩降临凡尘，担起守护众生的重任。十四年流放间罗摩降妖除魔，一步步激怒了罗波那。当妻子悉多被掳走，彻底点燃了罗摩心中的战意。

movies.title: Clayface
movies.synopsis: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 好莱坞新星马特·哈根遭犯罪头目毁容后，为恢复容貌接受先进治疗，却意外陷入疯狂，走上复仇之路。

movies.title: Pressure
movies.tagline: In the hours before D-Day, one decision changed the world.
movies.synopsis: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 1944年，诺曼底登陆进入最后72小时，盟军大规模登陆部队已经集结完毕，一切准备就绪，唯独难以预测的天气成为决定行动成败的关键。气象学家詹姆斯·斯塔格上校根据自己的判断预警风暴即将来临，但推迟行动同样可能导致盟军部署暴露。面对来自盟军高层的巨大压力，斯塔格必须坚持自己的气象判断，而最终决定权则掌握在盟军最高司令德怀特·艾森豪威尔手中。数十万将士的安危与诺曼底登陆的成败，都悬于这场与时间和天气的艰难博弈之中……

movies.title: Disney’s Hexed
movies.synopsis: Currently screening in cinemas. Select a session time for auditorium details and official venue booking.

movies.title: Sense and Sensibility
movies.countryOrigin: United Kingdom / United States of America
movies.tagline: No one knows your heart like a sister.
movies.synopsis: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自简·奥斯汀的同名经典名著。乔治亚时期英格兰，达什伍德先生去世后，遗孀与三名女儿失去庄园继承权，被迫迁居乡间简陋房屋。长女埃莉诺与次女玛丽安在拮据处境与社会压力下各自面对求婚、心碎与对真爱的探寻。

movies.title: The Legend of 1900
movies.tagline: An epic story of a man who could do anything... except be ordinary
movies.synopsis: Musician Max Tooney goes to sell his prized Conn trumpet to a music shop, where he plays the instrument one last time. The shopkeeper recognises the song as one on a record matrix he found and asks who the piece is by. Tooney tells the story of an infant found abandoned in the first class dining room of the four-stacker ocean-liner SS Virginian on 1 January 1900. Danny Boodman, a coal-man from the boiler room, names the boy Danny Boodman T. D. Lemon 1900, after himself, the fruit crate the boy was found in, and the year, and raises him as his own.
movies.chineseTagline: 这是一个关于一个无所不能的男人的史诗故事……唯独无法平凡。
movies.chineseSynopsis: 1900年，一个被遗弃的婴儿出现在往返欧美的弗吉尼亚号上，被船上的锅炉工丹尼收养，并以新世纪的年份取名为“1900”。丹尼意外去世后，1900继续在船上长大，并逐渐展现出无师自通的惊人钢琴天赋，成为弗吉尼亚号上的钢琴师。他的演奏吸引着来自世界各地的乘客，也让他与小号手麦克斯结下深厚友谊。然而无论船只多少次靠岸，1900始终没有真正踏上陆地，对他而言，这艘船和八十八个琴键就是自己熟悉的整个世界。直到一次偶然的邂逅，让从未离开过大海的他第一次认真考虑走下弗吉尼亚号，面对那个没有边界的陌生世界……

movies.title: Blue Heron
movies.tagline: A testament to the things we carry with us.
movies.synopsis: A family of six's fresh start on 1990s Vancouver Island unravels as their youngest child, Sasha, witnesses the increasingly dangerous behavior of her older brother, Jeremy.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 20世纪90年代末，8岁的萨莎随匈牙利移民家庭搬到温哥华岛开始新生活。然而，哥哥杰里米日益危险的行为打破了家庭的平静，父母也被迫面对艰难的选择。

movies.title: Love Test
movies.synopsis: A woman stages her own disappearance to test her boyfriend's love, only for him to quickly start a passionate relationship with another woman who unknowingly becomes entangled in the original scheme.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 为了测试男友丁伯阳对自己的爱，万影策划了一场失踪事件，让丁伯阳陷入短暂的痛苦中。此时，年轻惹火的马娅趁机上位，与丁伯阳光速热恋，激情同居。可马娅不知道的是，打从自己搬进丁伯阳家的一刻起，自己也成为了这场试探游戏的危险玩家之一…

movies.title: I Love Boosters
movies.tagline: Booster: Somebody who steals clothes from a store and sells them at a discount price, aka community service.
movies.synopsis: A group of shoplifters take aim at a cutthroat fashion maven by stealing from her stores and reselling them at a lower price — what they call 'fashion-forward philanthropy'.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 在旧金山湾区一个超现实的平行世界里，一群被称为"顺风手"的商店扒手，将矛头对准了一位剽窃他们设计的心狠手辣的冷酷时尚大亨。

movies.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour

douban.chineseTitle: 乔治·迈克尔：信念巡回演唱会

movies.synopsis: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

movies.title: Hexed
movies.synopsis: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 一名冲动、不拘一格的少女比莉意外发现自己拥有隐藏的魔法能力，由此进入广阔的女巫王国赫克塞。她与谨慎的母亲艾丽丝联手，揭开可能改变女巫世界的家族秘密。

movies.title: O.M: Operation Mole
movies.synopsis: Set across the temple corridors of Tirupati and Tiruvannamalai, an elite undercover operative infiltrates a sprawling transnational red sanders syndicate. As criminal politics escalate, a covert task force launches Operation Mole to dismantle the cartel from within.

movies.title: Chopin
movies.synopsis: He is the talk of the town, the most romantic figure of decadent Parisian nights. When his lungs start bleeding, Chopin knows his days are numbered. Composing becomes his only obsession. The ticking clock rushes him to revolutionize music.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 1835年的巴黎，著名作曲家弗雷德里克·肖邦周旋于上流社会，一边举办音乐会、教琴以维持生计，一边与疾病作斗争。他创作杰作，参加派对，在贵族和皇室圈子里寻觅爱情。

movies.title: Zombucha!
movies.synopsis: After one particularly catastrophic day at their respective workplaces, busy professionals Maddie and Leo find themselves both unemployed. Dreaming of a fresh start but needing reliable income to support the family they hope to start together, the couple have a chance encounter with Kai, a smouldering kombucha artisan raking in the cash. Seeing dollar signs, Maddie and Leo swipe Kai's kombucha culture to kickstart their own enterprise, but when they mix in some mysterious herbs from a neighbour's garden, the culture gains sentience and proves deadly. With their relationship hanging by a thread, can Maddie and Leo unite to prevent a full-blown zombucha apocalypse?

movies.title: Deep Quiet Room
movies.synopsis: After his pregnant wife Yi-ting unexpectedly committed suicide, Ming decides to take care of his father-in-law, only to find out the unbearable truth of Yi-ting’s family that leads to her death.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 影片改编自林秀赫同名短篇小说。讲述谕明与依庭相遇于大学图书馆里的深度安静区，两人相爱并走入婚姻，正期待迎接第一个孩子。然而，依庭的意外自杀让谕明陷入混乱与痛苦。他想起依庭在怀孕后变得异常，甚至提出离婚。自责的谕明照顾起依庭的家人，透过深入了解她的家庭后，开始理解她的行径，以及她无法面对自己父亲的原因，真相却让人难以接受。

movies.title: The Black Ball
movies.synopsis: Currently screening in cinemas. Select a session time for auditorium details and official venue booking.

movies.title: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East
movies.synopsis: Seeking a fresh start, chef Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to support his family and repay his debts. Alongside restaurant manager Ma Junsheng, he transforms the struggling Dragon Restaurant into a thriving business. But when war engulfs the city, their hard-won success is shattered and the restaurant becomes a refuge for those caught in the conflict. As danger closes in, Xu Fu must risk everything to protect his newfound community and preserve a small beacon of hope amid the devastation.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 根据真实事件改编。徐福为养家还债远赴中东，在当地结识大堂经理马俊生。两人以地道中国风味招揽食客，令龙餐馆生意兴隆。然而战争爆发，平静生活被打破，他们将如何面对命运的变故？

movies.title: The Odyssey
movies.countryOrigin: United Kingdom / United States of America
movies.synopsis: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 克里斯托弗·诺兰将荷马笔下的怪物搬上银幕，打造了一部在全球多地取景拍摄的神话动作史诗。这是一场无与伦比的电影盛事。[环球影业]

movies.title: Dune: Part Two
movies.synopsis: Follow the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a path of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, Paul endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自弗兰克·赫伯特的科幻小说《沙丘》。保罗·厄崔迪与契妮及弗雷曼人结盟，踏上向摧毁其家族的阴谋者复仇之路。面对挚爱与已知宇宙命运之间的抉择，他必须努力阻止自己预见的可怕未来。

movies.title: 金哲
movies.synopsis: Now screening in Melbourne and Sydney cinemas.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 1983年夏，七岁的尚民到吉童村姥姥家过暑假，遇见了被全村叫作"傻子"的金哲。山野间的疯跑嬉戏，抓河蚌、捉迷藏，让尚民读懂了他藏在"傻"背后的孤独，而这份不掺杂质的陪伴，也让长久被轻视的金哲，第一次萌生出了为自己赢一次的勇气。夏末，村里摔跤赛开场，金哲第一次代表村子站上赛场赢得尊严。

movies.title: 心迷宫之三重罪
movies.synopsis: Now screening in Melbourne and Sydney cinemas.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 一具烧焦的无名尸体被发现，引发邻里间的猜疑。大家都在怀疑小肖杀人，虎子的家人企图认尸躲避恶霸追债，琴儿则借尸体摆脱已无感情的丈夫，此时，又有一场意外发生………随着警方调查，真相逐渐浮现。

movies.title: Erupcja
movies.synopsis: A romantic vacation goes awry when a volcanic eruption strands Bethany and her boyfriend, Rob, in Warsaw, Poland. Taking the explosive event as a sign to ditch her baggage, Bethany reunites with her childhood friend, Nel, to traipse through lofts, clubs, and back alleys—all while becoming entangled in an emotional web that challenges her sense of self.

movies.title: Buddy
movies.synopsis: Inside the colorful world of "It's Buddy!", a group of children spend their days singing, dancing, and helping Buddy - bright orange unicorn - spread happiness. But when one child refuses to play along, Buddy is not pleased and cracks begin to appear in this seemingly perfect world.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 一群孩子被困在看似欢乐的儿童电视节目中。随着橙色独角兽布迪露出凶残本性，这个充满歌舞与欢笑的世界逐渐显露出恐怖真相。

movies.title: Chasing Millions
movies.tagline: And still chasing... A true(ish) story of a legendary bank job.
movies.synopsis: The Northern Bank chain was owned by the National Australia Bank. Diana, a young Australian police detective in Belfast at the same time, seizes the opportunity to investigate the biggest crime of her career and prove herself to her misogynistic bosses back home who have passed her over for promotion. Diana is teamed with Crawford, a gruff, veteran Northern Irish police detective who does not want her help. As the case takes one more bizarre turn after another, the duo learn to grudgingly respect each other. As they almost give up hope of catching the criminals, Diana comes up with an ingenious plan which will make the stolen millions worthless.

movies.title: La Bola Negra
movies.synopsis: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 三个同性恋男子在西班牙历史上1932 年、1937 年和 2017 年三个不同时期的故事。

douban.chineseTitle: 指环王：力量之戒 第三季

movies.title: Verity
movies.tagline: There is no light where we're going.
movies.synopsis: Lowen Ashleigh, hired to ghostwrite for best-selling author Verity Crawford, uncovers Verity's autobiographical notes, and becomes involved in what may prove to be a lethal conspiracy.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自科琳·胡佛的同名小说。知名作家维莉蒂·克劳福德因意外受伤后，洛温·阿什利受聘代笔完成她的系列小说，并搬进克劳福德家中。洛温意外发现维莉蒂令人不安的自传手稿，逐渐陷入真假难辨的秘密、操纵与执念之中。

movies.title: John Wick
movies.synopsis: Ex-hitman John Wick comes out of retirement to track down the gangsters that took everything from him.
movies.chineseTagline: 地表最强杀手 限时疾速追杀
movies.chineseSynopsis: 不久之前刚刚经历丧妻之痛的约翰·威克（基努·里维斯 Keanu Reeves 饰），未曾料到磨难与折磨接二连三袭来。他那辆1964年的福特老爷车被一伙俄罗斯小混混盯上，旋即引来对方入室抢劫，心爱的狗狗被当场杀死，约翰也遭到无情毒打，那辆老爷车自然被对方抢走。偷车的混混（阿尔菲·艾伦 Alfie Allen 饰）是黑帮大佬维格·塔拉索夫（迈克尔·恩奎斯特 Michael Nyqvist 饰）的儿子，而维格在听说这件事后显得紧张非常，因为约翰有着令人胆战心惊的身份。他曾是名震江湖的冷血杀手，当年替塔拉索夫杀掉不少难缠的对手，后来却为了妻子金盆洗手。愤怒至极的约翰拒绝塔拉索夫的调解，他决定单枪匹马展开复仇……

movies.title: Aakasamlo Oka Tara
movies.synopsis: A girl from a remote village dreams of becoming an astronaut and wishes to defy the odds and doubts from those around her.

movies.title: Heart of the Beast
movies.synopsis: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 一名前陆军特种部队士兵与他退役战犬在阿拉斯加深处遭遇坠机事故后，这对老搭档必须在环境严酷的极地荒野中相互扶持，为生存而战。

movies.title: 500 Miles
movies.synopsis: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 16岁的芬恩和弟弟查理为避免父母分居后被拆散，连夜离家，从英国前往爱尔兰西海岸寻找与家人疏远的祖父，踏上一场跨越500英里的旅程。

movies.title: Savage House
movies.tagline: Polite society has never been so Savage.
movies.synopsis: Against the backdrop of 18th century England, a massive pox outbreak, and Jacobite uprising – Sir Chauncey Savage and Lady Savage blindly pursue a better life. It's not without a tinge of irony that their family name is the Savages, for this is a Savage House indeed, filled with duels, decadence, and bloodshed.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 故事设定在18世纪的英国，正值天花大流行与詹姆斯党起义的动荡时期。萨维奇爵士与野心勃勃的妻子萨维奇夫人，不顾一切地追逐地位与财富。他们对时代灾难视而不见，疯狂的执念让家族庄园沦为荒诞、奢靡与血腥的舞台：决斗频发、联盟在晚宴上轻易崩塌，家族姓氏“Savage”（野蛮）成了绝妙讽刺。这是一部黑色讽刺喜剧，辛辣解构阶级、权力与人性的贪婪 。

movies.title: Parky
movies.synopsis: How did a miner’s son from working-class Yorkshire, who rose to become television’s greatest interviewer and die a knighted Sir, never truly believe in himself? A revelatory portrait of Michael Parkinson – the man behind the ‘Parky’ icon as told in his own words and from those closest to him.

movies.title: Demigod: The Legend Begins
movies.synopsis: The martial artist Su Hua-Jen has risked his life clambering to the summit of one of the five sacred mountains of Wu Lin, only to come across two monstrous beings in battle. His timely intervention turns the tide of the fight, and unbeknownst to him, sets in motion a series of monumentally consequential events. Back in the city, Su has a more mundane problem to face—an enormous debt with the local book lender. To pay this off, he must peddle his remarkable skills as a physician. While Su would prefer to steer clear of the affairs of the martial arts world, a request from the Lord of Globe Castle is financially promising—and might gain him access to the Fantastic Academy, where he can feast his eyes on the Limitless Celestial Book. But treachery is afoot, and Su is soon drawn into a crisis that will rock the foundations of Heaven and Earth.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 少年素还真身怀绝艺，初入江湖原想见识广大世界，却因为新结识的好友卷入了险恶的夺权纷争，就连他的老师都因他遭难。

movies.title: Steal This Story, Please!
movies.synopsis: New York-based independent investigative journalist Amy Goodman has been reporting from hotspots around the world for decades: from East Timor to Morocco, Nigeria, and Gaza, and closer to home during 9/11 and the Iraq War. Goodman and a small group of colleagues present the daily online, TV, and radio news program Democracy Now!, which has been on the air since 1996 with no government funding, thanks to contributions from donors, foundations, and news consumers.

movies.title: Coyote vs. Acme
movies.tagline: The movie ACME doesn't want you to see.
movies.synopsis: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自1990年《纽约客》的一篇同名文章。饱受ACME产品故障之苦的歪心狼决定反击，与律师凯文·艾弗里联手，将这家唯利是图的跨国企业告上法庭。

movies.title: Street Fighter
movies.synopsis: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自卡普空同名系列格斗游戏。1993年，昔日形同兄弟的街头格斗家隆与肯因春丽的邀请重返赛场，参加世界格斗王大赛。然而，一场致命阴谋潜伏其中，迫使两人再次面对彼此与各自的过去。

movies.title: GIANT – The Play
movies.synopsis: Currently screening in cinemas. Select a session time for auditorium details and official venue booking.

movies.title: Happy Birthday
movies.synopsis: Eight-year-old maid Toha goes to great lengths to ensure that her best friend Nelly, the daughter of her wealthy employer, has a successful birthday party in this poignant debut feature exploring classism in modern-day Cairo.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 八岁的小女孩托哈在开罗一个富裕家庭当童工女仆，并与雇主的女儿奈莉建立了特殊的联系。从未庆祝过自己生日的托哈下定决心要为奈莉举办一场完美的生日派对，她暗自希望借此体验到自己从未感受过的快乐。

movies.title: Tenzing
movies.synopsis: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 根据真实事件改编。喜马拉雅登山家丹增·诺盖与新西兰登山家埃德蒙·希拉里携手登顶珠穆朗玛峰，成为首批登顶者。在妻子达瓦和探险队秘书吉尔·亨德森的支持下，丹增争取加入英国登山队，在攀登过程中面对文化差异、阶级矛盾与高山险境。

movies.title: The History of Concrete
movies.tagline: Wow! What a Material! It Makes Up Sidewalks!
movies.synopsis: After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, filmmaker John Wilson tries to use the same formula to sell a documentary about concrete.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 在参加了一个关于如何创作和销售霍尔马克电影的研讨会后，电影制作人约翰·威尔逊试图用同样的套路来推销一部关于混凝土的纪录片。

movies.title: The Devils
movies.tagline: Hell will hold no surprises for them...
movies.synopsis: In 1634 France, charismatic Father Urbain Grandier becomes the target of sexually depraved Sister Jeanne's accusations of witchcraft, which corrupt officials of church and state are all too happy to exploit.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自阿尔多斯·赫胥黎的历史纪实作品《卢丹的恶魔》及约翰·怀廷的同名戏剧。17世纪的法国，于尔班·格兰第神父被指控对一群修女施行巫术。随着修道院爆发集体附魔事件，宗教狂热与政治权力相互勾结，将他卷入一场迫害风暴。

movies.title: God forgives everyone
movies.synopsis: Arturo is a lonely, gluttonous, and disillusioned Sicilian real estate agent. His mundane life finally finds its spark through his one true passion: Sicilian pastries. It’s over a tray of cannoli that he meets his soulmate, Flora. She is everything he ever dreamed of—beautiful, witty, and brilliant. To top it off, she’s a pastry chef.  However, a divine obstacle stands between them: God.  While Flora is a devout, fervent Catholic, Arturo abandoned his faith as a child. Desperate not to lose the woman of his dreams, he decides to "fake it 'til he makes it," pretending to be a man of deep conviction. Guiding Arturo on this chaotic journey toward truth, faith, and Flora’s heart is an unlikely mentor and friend: Pope Francis himself.

movies.title: The Three Urns
movies.synopsis: Back in his home country to spread the ashes of his beloved wife, a man races to his destination. In a milk float. Chased by a beautiful French woman in a smart car, plagued with battery issues.

movies.title: Live Flesh
movies.tagline: Life, love, desire... and everything in between.
movies.synopsis: When Victor attempts to seduce Elena, all he gets for his trouble is a one-way, six-year ticket to prison, where he concentrates on strengthening his mind, his body... and his desire for vengeance on the man who put him there. After his release and still madly in love with her, Victor will stop at nothing to win her over even if means revenge, for Elena has married David, the cop who sent him to prison!
movies.chineseTagline: 生命、爱情、欲望……以及其间的一切。
movies.chineseSynopsis: 1970年，平安夜。妓女伊莎贝尔（佩内洛普•克鲁兹 Penélope Cruz 饰）临盆在即，情急之下，老鸨舍命拦车，结果她在车上产下一子，取名维克多。20年后，维克多爱上了跟他有染的女孩艾莲娜，但约会却被放鸽子。气愤的维克多登门造访，被犯毒瘾的艾莲娜以枪相逼。两人僵持时，警察桑丘和大卫（贾维尔•巴登 Javier Bardem 饰）刚好经过。此前，醉酒驾车的桑丘正在跟同事倾诉老婆偷情之事。在对抗中，大卫被维克多射伤导致下肢瘫痪，后者因此锒铛入狱。6年后，入狱期满的维克多在电视中看到了残疾运动员大卫，后者代表西班牙队参加92年巴塞罗那残奥会，并赢得了篮球金牌。维克多要找大卫复仇，却跟大卫妻子成了同事，这阴错阳差的背后竟隐藏着惊人的秘密……

movies.title: A Talent for Murder
movies.tagline: The end is where the plotting begins.
movies.synopsis: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 爱德华打断了海史密斯在瑞士阿尔卑斯山孤独的晚年生活。爱德华是一位年轻的文学经纪人，受出版公司的委托，说服她为人气很高的雷普利系列写最后一部小说。海史密斯用她出名的恐怖想象力把爱德华吓跑了，不过在他们意识到之前，一场合作已经开始了，这让两人难以区分他们构建的世界和他们生活的世界。

movies.title: Frank and Percy
movies.tagline: It's never too late to fall in love.
movies.synopsis: During their dog walks on Hampstead Heath, two older gentlemen find their conversations about everyday aches and weather growing into an unexpected connection.

movies.title: Virginia Woolf's Night and Day

douban.chineseTitle: 弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫的夜与日

movies.countryOrigin: United Kingdom / United States of America
movies.synopsis: In 1910 London, an independent-minded young woman challenges her family’s expectations of marriage to pursue astronomy, questioning the restrictions of society, love, and tradition as she searches for a life of her own.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 讲述了两位女性在爱德华时代的伦敦，通过爱情的磨砺，最终打破传统束缚、寻找真实自我的故事。这不仅是一个关于“选对伴侣”的爱情故事，更是关于女性如何在“传统（夜）”与“现实（日）”中觉醒，勇敢掌控自己命运的独立宣言。

movies.title: Hideaway: The Dossiers
movies.synopsis: A secret archive documenting the earliest revolutionary work of the Chinese Communist Party—the "Central Archives"—was successfully protected through the resilience and sacrifices of its guardians (both Party members and non-members) amid the turmoil and bloodshed from 1931 to 1949.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 大革命失败，绝密的中共文件藏匿于一幢人蛇混杂的居民楼。在腥风血雨的环境中，中共文档保管员突破敌伪围剿，在完成延安高难度“调档”任务的同时，将所有秘密文件转移至安全之地。影片取材早期党史的真实历史事件。

movies.title: NT Live: Golden Boy
movies.synopsis: Currently screening in cinemas. Select a session time for auditorium details and official venue booking.

movies.title: JIFF: The Sea
movies.synopsis: Currently screening in cinemas. Select a session time for auditorium details and official venue booking.

movies.title: Digger
movies.tagline: A man. A plan. A meltdown.
movies.synopsis: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 世界上最有权势的男子极力证明自己其实是人类的救世主，结果等来了他酝酿的灾难要摧毁万物。

movies.title: The Fox
movies.tagline: A story of two friends who didn't know they were supposed to be enemies.
movies.synopsis: When a feisty little fox named Tod is adopted into a farm family, he quickly becomes friends with a fun and adorable hound puppy named Copper. Life is full of hilarious adventures until Copper is expected to take on his role as a hunting dog -- and the object of his search is his best friend!
movies.chineseSynopsis: 两个从小一起长大的狐狸陶德和猎狗小铜之间的友情，正面临一场大考验。在猫头鹰保姆的保护下，两个在林中尽情嬉闹的小家伙，全然不知猎狗天生就要追捕狐狸的对峙命运；而且，对立的时刻又一天一天逼近……本片画面唯美，荣获1994年美国年度最佳录影带殊荣。

movies.title: Hill
movies.synopsis: Rose, a desperate mother, takes her adopted daughter, Sharon, to the town of Silent Hill in an attempt to cure her of her ailment. After a violent car crash, Sharon disappears, and Rose embarks on a horrific journey to get her back and begins to uncover the truth behind the apocalyptic disaster that burned the town 30 years earlier.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 萝丝发现自己收养的养女雪伦患有梦游症且多次提及小镇‘寂静岭’。萝丝为了寻求真相，带着莎伦前往那个叫寂静岭的地方。但是罗斯遭遇车祸，醒来发现莎伦失踪并且自己困在异界；在寻找女儿时，她接触了当地的一个宗教组织，同时发现了莎伦与这个小镇的黑暗过去有着重大联系。

movies.title: RBO Cinema Season 2026-27: Manon
movies.synopsis: Currently screening in cinemas. Select a session time for auditorium details and official venue booking.

movies.title: For Better or Worse
movies.synopsis: When they first met at Yuan Bo's secularization party, Li Xinran was still an actress suffering from depression. The two, both at the lowest point in their lives, fell in love at first sight and quickly came together, welcoming their first child. With several million yuan in savings, they envisioned an ideal life, but due to extravagance and a lack of financial management experience, they fell into an economic crisis. To turn their situation around, Yuan Bo planned to establish a handpan instrument factory in the mountains of Anji. The lush greenery seemed like their utopian dream. However, with the birth of their second child, their business failed, their business partner left, and they were burdened with debt. The daily grind and financial pressure gradually eroded their once passionate relationship. Deep in the mountains, they loved each other until they had nothing left but each other.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 相识于原博的还俗派对时，李欣冉还是位身患抑郁症的女演员。处于人生低谷的俩人一见钟情，他们迅速走到一起，迎来第一个孩子。带着几百万积蓄，他们憧憬着理想生活，却因挥霍和缺乏理财经验，陷入了经济危机。为扭转困境，原博计划在安吉山中创办手碟乐器工厂。青山绿水似乎是他们梦想中的乌托邦。然而，随着第二个孩子的降生，事业夭折，合伙人离开，债务缠身。日常琐碎与经济压力逐渐蚕食了曾经炙热的感情。在深山中，他们爱到一无所有，只剩彼此。

movies.title: Mr. & Mrs. Pardon
movies.synopsis: Middle-aged couple Shen Mo and Tian Yi, facing their third seven-year itch, see their marriage erupt in a bitter clash of accumulated frustration, culminating in a 30-day cooling-off period that seems destined to conclude their relationship.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 沈默和天意是一对中年夫妻，正在经历婚姻的第三个七年之痒，锅碗瓢盆的碰撞，终于让积压许久的烦躁、嫌弃和失望彻底爆发，三十天的离婚冷静期，即将奏响他们婚姻的终曲。

movies.title: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth

douban.chineseTitle: 克里夫·布斯的惊险再冒险

movies.synopsis: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 在《好莱坞往事》事件发生八年后，克里夫·布斯回到日新月异的洛杉矶。他在好莱坞制片厂体系的阴影下以一名片场问题处理人的身份谋生，却发现自己卷入了一张由秘密、罪行与背叛交织而成的危险罗网——这一切将彻底考验他对忠诚与生存的全部认知。

movies.title: JIFF: Women on Trial
movies.synopsis: Currently screening in cinemas. Select a session time for auditorium details and official venue booking.

movies.title: Butterfly Stroke
movies.synopsis: Ruth is an eccentric, determined woman who wants control over everything. Even death. So, she goes to Zurich for a tidy, orderly exit. But her chaotic granddaughter Lori gatecrashes, and will not go back home without her. They have an unexpected holiday together.

movies.title: Everybody to Kenmure Street
movies.synopsis: In May 2021, a UK Home Office dawn raid triggers one of the most spontaneous and successful acts of civil resistance in recent memory. In Pollokshields, Scotland’s most diverse neighbourhood, hundreds of residents rush to the streets to stop the deportation of their neighbours.

movies.title: California Schemin'
movies.countryOrigin: United Kingdom / United States of America
movies.synopsis: After being ridiculed for their Scottish accents, two ambitious musicians reinvent themselves as American rappers and fool the British music industry into a lucrative record deal, only for their elaborate lie to unravel under the weight of instant fame.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 影片聚焦一起真实的骗局：00年代初，两个苏格兰邓迪走出的男子想闯说唱界，但因为口音而被拒绝、破产，于是他俩操起美国口音，假扮成一个在加州享有盛名的rapper组合——Silibil N' Brains，以此实现他们的唱片合约梦。随着名利的诱惑和谎言的堆积，他们的友谊受到了考验。

movies.title: Onwards and Sideways
movies.synopsis: Tony Evans is the deputy head of a local primary school. Emma Dretzin is a pianist, composer and single mother of two daughters. Neither knows the other until a startling encounter changes the course of their lives: on the same morning, they are both confronted with a diagnosis of Parkinson’s.

movies.title: NAZA
movies.countryOrigin: United States of America / United Kingdom
movies.tagline: A window into systems of mass killing.
movies.synopsis: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 影片在夜晚的特拉维夫屋顶拍摄，揭示以色列在加沙对巴勒斯坦平民实施大规模杀戮背后的系统。

movies.title: Blink Your Eyes
movies.synopsis: Now screening in Melbourne and Sydney cinemas.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 一次伸手相助的善意让黎响（佟丽娅 饰）被判过失杀人，不甘心的她携手失意律师韩铮（王皓 饰），与多年未见的三位老友王海燕（王智 饰）、李欣怡（吴优 饰）、刘思涵（王丽坤 饰），一同踏上和时间赛跑的寻证之路。

movies.title: The Cat in the Hat
movies.countryOrigin: United Kingdom / United States of America
movies.tagline: The cat's out of the bag.
movies.synopsis: Assigned his toughest mission yet, the Cat must cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian as they adjust to life in a new town. Known for pushing boundaries, this agent of chaos must prove himself or risk losing his magical hat forever.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自苏斯博士创作的同名儿童绘本。一只古灵精怪的猫接到最艰巨的任务：帮助一对因搬家而闷闷不乐的兄妹加比和塞巴斯蒂安重拾快乐。这场充满魔法与恶作剧的冒险，也可能成为他证明自己的最后机会，否则就将失去魔法帽。

movies.title: We Live in Time
movies.synopsis: An up-and-coming chef and a recent divorcée find their lives forever changed when a chance encounter brings them together, in a decade-spanning, deeply moving romance.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 阿尔穆特与托比亚斯因一次意外相遇，人生从此改变。两人相恋、组建家庭，在时间的考验与生活的变故中，学会珍惜彼此相伴的每一刻。

movies.title: Penguin Island
movies.synopsis: The film—exclusive to museum/aquarium cinemas—will take audiences to the untouched landscapes of a fantastical island wilderness, home to one of the most iconic and beloved animals on the planet. Shot on the dramatic and uninhabited sub-Antarctic Crozet Archipelago, home to over half a million breeding pairs of penguins, the film chronicles the arrival of a lone, determined male suitor, driven by instinct to return to this treeless mote in the vast Southern seas. Here, against all odds, he must find a special someone among a cacophony of colony rivals, protect a precious egg, and start a family.

movies.title: Marie Antoinette
movies.synopsis: A retelling of the story of France’s iconic but ill-fated queen, Marie Antoinette - from her betrothal and marriage to Louis XVI at fifteen to her reign as queen at nineteen and ultimately the fall of Versailles.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 这部电影讲述了一位法兰西王后的一生，讲述了那个年代，法国大革命前贵族们奢华迷乱的生活。奥地利公主玛丽（克尔斯滕·邓斯特 Kirsten Dunst饰）非常聪明，生性活泼，14岁的时候，在一场政治婚姻中，从奥地利公主变成法国的太子妃。由于某些原因，王子对玛丽非常的纵容，婚后，玛丽一直过着极其奢华的生活，同样，玛丽也一直无法与内心的寂寞彻底脱离。这部电影将给我们带来关于18世纪法国宫廷和社会的各种震撼，匪夷所思的奢侈，欲望交织的爱情，以及最后法国人民的怒吼。

movies.title: The Shawshank Redemption
movies.tagline: Fear can hold you prisoner. Hope can set you free.
movies.synopsis: Imprisoned in the 1940s for the double murder of his wife and her lover, upstanding banker Andy Dufresne begins a new life at the Shawshank prison, where he puts his accounting skills to work for an amoral warden. During his long stretch in prison, Dufresne comes to be admired by the other inmates -- including an older prisoner named Red -- for his integrity and unquenchable sense of hope.
movies.chineseTagline: 恐惧会将你囚禁，希望则能让你获得自由。
movies.chineseSynopsis: 1947年，银行家安迪·杜佛兰因被控杀害妻子及其情人，尽管始终坚称清白，仍被判处两项无期徒刑，送入缅因州的肖申克监狱服刑。在残酷而压抑的监狱生活中，安迪凭借冷静、智慧和始终未曾熄灭的希望逐渐赢得狱友们的尊重，并与能够在狱中弄到各种物品的瑞德建立起深厚的友谊。漫长的岁月里，他始终没有让高墙彻底改变自己，也开始用自己的方式影响身边的人，以及这座看似牢不可破的监狱……

movies.title: Volcanoes

douban.chineseTitle: 英格麗褒曼vs. 安娜麥蘭妮

movies.synopsis: In 1948, a fan letter arrived for director Roberto Rossellini from Ingrid Bergman, one of Hollywood’s biggest stars; after a meeting in New York, Rossellini invited Bergman to Italy to work on a project. Meanwhile, Anna Magnani, one of Italy’s biggest stars and Rossellini’s longtime lover, was furious. When the Rossellini/Bergman project was announced as a tale set on Stromboli, one of the volcanic Aeolian Islands, Magnani quickly set up her own Aeolian project, financed by Hollywood, to be called Volcano. Italy’s tabloids simply went wild: the prospect of these two great divas battling it out with rival productions was breathlessly followed, especially as it became clear that the Rossellini/Bergman relationship was more than professional. Francesco Patierno has created an engrossing, revealing and highly entertaining chronicle of this cinematic battle royal.

movies.title: The Secret of Seagull Island
movies.synopsis: A woman searches for her blind sister in this feature-length English-language cut of the TV miniseries Seagull Island (1981).

movies.title: A Beautiful Planet
movies.synopsis: A breathtaking portrait of Earth from space, providing a unique perspective and increased understanding of our planet and galaxy as never seen before. Made in cooperation with the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA), the film features stunning footage of our magnificent blue planet — and the effects humanity has had on it over time — captured by the astronauts aboard the International Space Station (ISS).
movies.chineseTagline: 体验前所未见的地球之美。
movies.chineseSynopsis: 影片通过国际空间站宇航员的视角近距离呈现摄人心魄的地球美景，同时带您一同探寻这个美丽星球的未来模样。在这段激动人心的环球之旅中，您将看到日益美丽的湛蓝地球，伴着游若细丝的浮云，在阳光下闪闪发光。

movies.title: Extreme Weather
movies.synopsis: EXTREME WEATHER is an up-close look at some of the most astonishing and potentially deadly natural phenomena, tornadoes, glaciers, and wildfires while showing how they are interconnected and changing our world in dramatic ways.

movies.title: The Legend of the Swordsman
movies.synopsis: Ling Wu Chung decides to hide from the chaotic world. Before leaving, he visits his friends, a tribe of snake-wielding women warriors. However, he finds that the tribe have been attacked, and their leader Yam Ying Ying has been abducted.
movies.chineseTagline: 天下风云出我辈,一入江湖岁月催。 皇图霸业谈笑中,不胜人间一场醉
movies.chineseSynopsis: 华山派大弟子令狐冲（李连杰 饰）在经历江湖纷争后，本欲与师妹岳灵珊（李嘉欣 饰）及众师弟一同归隐，退出江湖。然而，此时的武林正被一场巨大阴谋笼罩。日月神教教主东方不败（林青霞 饰）凭借绝世武功《葵花宝典》篡权，囚禁了原教主任我行（任世官 饰），并勾结东瀛浪人，意图颠覆朝廷。 令狐冲在途中偶遇一位超凡脱俗的神秘女子，两人月下对饮，引为知己，令狐冲更对这位女子暗生情愫。他全然不知，眼前这位佳人，正是他受朋友任盈盈（关之琳 饰）和蓝凤凰（袁洁莹 饰）所托、计划要铲除的魔教枭雄东方不败。 与此同时，东方不败为巩固权势，开始铲除教内异己。当令狐冲得知自己的同门师兄弟惨遭东方不败毒手时，他义愤填膺，决心联手任盈盈、向问天（刘洵 饰）以及被救出的任我行，攻上黑木崖，为同门报仇。 在最终的决战中，令狐冲震惊地发现，那个与自己有过一段情缘、刻骨铭心的神秘女子，竟然就是他要手刃的仇敌东方不败。爱恨交织与江湖大义在前，两人展开了一场惊天动地的生死对决。东方不败虽武功盖世，但因对令狐冲手下留情，最终坠下悬崖。 风波平息后，重掌大权的任我行变得与昔日的东方不败一样专横，开始大肆清除异己。令狐冲看透江湖权力斗争的循环与虚妄，心灰意冷之下，选择携师妹岳灵珊浪迹天涯，真正远离这个纷扰的江湖。

movies.title: Shanghai Wonton
movies.synopsis: The film tells the story of a retired father who comes to the park's dating corner to find a marriage partner for his son, but inadvertently gets involved in an emotional whirlpool.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 退休工程师老汪一直走不出丧妻的阴影，时常恍惚间觉得妻子素娟仍在身边，与自己说话。每周六，儿子小汪都会回家看望他，吃一碗父亲亲手包的菜肉馄饨。见面时，老汪总免不了催促儿子找女朋友、结婚成家，小汪却常常找借口溜走。为了儿子的终身大事，老汪来到人民公园相亲角替他征婚，并在那里结识了林美琴、老金和阿芳。几人逐渐成为朋友，老汪也在他们的陪伴下慢慢走出封闭的生活，开始吃饭、跳舞、喝下午茶，重新发现生活的乐趣。而同样经历丧偶的退休教师林美琴，也渐渐走进了他的生活……

movies.title: Wild Asia
movies.synopsis: Atop the world’s tallest peaks of the Himalayas, get an intimate look at elusive Snow Leopards and Tiger moms in Nepal raising their young. Witness a Tibetan Fox ‘hide-and-seek hunting’ amongst yaks on an ancient plateau, catch glimpses of the secretive red panda in its remote forest stronghold, meet the remarkable long-eared jumping Jerboa in the harsh Gobi Desert, and fly alongside beautiful songbirds feeding on “sapcicles” in northern Japan. In the world’s richest coral seas of the Pacific, discover the cute-yet-deadly Sea Bunny and be immersed in an unbelievable shark feeding frenzy, that’s never been filmed before. Each story reveals the incredible ways in which wildlife has adapted to thrive in these challenging habitats.

movies.title: Hamlet
movies.tagline: Something is rotten in the state of Denmark.
movies.synopsis: Hamlet, Prince of Denmark, returns home to find his father murdered and his mother now marrying the murderer... his uncle. Meanwhile, war is brewing.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 本片由莎士比亚的著名悲剧改编而成，该剧以中世纪的丹麦宫廷为背景，通过哈姆雷特为父报仇的故事，借古喻今，真实的描绘了文艺复兴时期欧洲和英国社会社会的现实与矛盾，宫廷中尔虞我诈，社会上民怨沸腾，人文主义理想在这个罪恶当道的社会已无法实现。

movies.title: Super Nature
movies.tagline: A love letter to nature, created on Super 8
movies.synopsis: We’re invited on a journey across 25 different countries, with people embracing both abundance and loss, to feel a sense of togetherness with our fellow dwellers on earth, human and non-human. Celebrating all we have and reflecting on all we have to lose, Super Nature proposes a new way of seeing.

movies.title: Storm Over The South-China Sea
movies.synopsis: Dramatic representation of the Battle of the Paracel Islands (1974) between the China and South Vietnam.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 1970年代初，南越敌舰不顾国际法约束，经常窜入我西沙海域骚扰，严重影响我边疆渔民海上作业。居住在西沙群岛的于化龙（唐国强 饰）一家祖祖辈辈生活在这里，一天，正在海上捕鱼的一家人遭遇闯入我领海的南越10号舰，阿爸（高保成 饰）驾渔轮和敌舰展开周旋，但最终渔轮被敌舰撞翻，全家人落入大海。幸而被我赶来的海军救起，于化龙决定报名参军，保卫祖国海防。入伍后，于化龙从一个普通水兵成长为舰长，上级命令严惩不断入侵的南越舰艇，于化龙的阿爸和妹妹（洪学敏 饰）也参加了海战。战斗中，我舰中弹受损，于化龙急令修复，并一举收复了甜水岛，击溃了登岛的敌人，敌舰长也命丧黄泉...

movies.title: The True Story of Jesse James

douban.chineseTitle: 杰西·詹姆斯的真实故事

movies.tagline: The real story… really told for the first time!
movies.synopsis: Having fought with the Confederacy during the Civil War, Jesse James and his brother Frank dream of a farm life in Missouri. Harassed by Union sympathizers, they assemble a gang of outlaws, robbing trains and becoming folk heroes in the process. Jesse marries his sweetheart, Zee, and maintains an aura of domesticity, but after a group of lawmen launch an attack on his mother's house, Jesse plans one more great raid -- on a Minnesota bank.
movies.chineseTagline: 真实的故事……首次得以完整呈现！
movies.chineseSynopsis: 美国内战期间曾为南方邦联作战的杰西·詹姆斯和哥哥弗兰克梦想在密苏里州经营农场生活。由于遭到联邦支持者的不断侵扰，他们集结了一帮亡命之徒，通过劫掠火车成为民间传说中的英雄。杰西迎娶了心上人齐，维持着家庭生活的表象，但当一群执法人员突袭他母亲的住宅后，杰西策划了最后一次大型劫案——目标直指明尼苏达州的银行。

movies.title: Bugs 3D: Micro Monsters
movies.tagline: The Smallest Creatures Have The Greatest Powers
movies.synopsis: Super powers exist. Right here on Earth. And they are beneath our feet. They include beetles that shoot chemical fire and lift enormous weights; scorpions that glow in the dark with astonishing crushing powers; spiders that can make themselves virtually invisible and hypnotise their prey; even a bug that can transform itself into another creature entirely.  Prepare to be amazed in this 3D giant screen adventure, with narration from the likes of world renowned naturalist David Attenborough, which explores the hidden world of the super-powered bugs.

movies.title: Flight of the Butterflies
movies.synopsis: It takes two or three generations for the monarch butterfly to reach the Canadian breeding grounds, but it is one "supergeneration" that makes the 2,000 mile return trip back south into central Mexico. The documentary film covers Dr Fred Urquhart's interest in monarch butterflies, with perspectives of Urquhart as a child wondering where the butterflies went, his years of research and study into their life and migration, to his time decades-later as a senior scientist looking back at his investigations and discoveries about the insect's life pattern.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 以震撼人心的画面以及先进的3D技术，讲述了自然界的一大奇迹--帝王蝶的迁徙。每年秋天，帝王蝶以数百万只的规模，飞越千山万水，数千公里的路程，从美国和加拿大飞到墨西哥中部的墨西哥州和米却肯州过冬，次年3月底再飞往加拿大。影片不仅用壮观的画面展现了自然界最不可思议的生物大迁徙，并且向观众展现了科学家的执着与认真，此片正是他们40多年研究结果的完美展示。

movies.title: Antarctica
movies.tagline: Amidst the coldest, harshest surroundings on earth, this true story celebrates the mystery and the warmth of life.
movies.synopsis: Two Japanese scientists, Ushioda and Ochi, develop a bond with their sled dogs while on an expedition in Antarctica.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 1958年2月，观测船派飞机接走了南极昭和基地的第一批考察队员们，临走时潮田等人把15只桦太犬拴好，留给即将前来接替的第二批队员。不料，由于天气极度恶劣，第二批队员无法飞赴基地，原计划被迫取消，所有队员将一起回国。潮田和越智强烈要求接回那些桦太犬，但终究无法办到。潮田归国后无法摆脱内心的歉疚，辞去了北海道大学讲师之职，一一走访提供桦太犬的人家前去谢罪。在越智的推动下，稚内市内修铸起了一座铜像纪念这些牺牲的桦太犬。同时，在冰天雪地的南极，有8条桦太犬挣脱了束缚外出寻找食物，在严酷的环境中，它们陆续死去。一年后科学考察队再次来到了南极。回到基地的潮田和越智发现了幸存的两条桦太犬……

movies.title: Museum Alive

douban.chineseTitle: 爱丁保罗夫爷爷的博物馆奇妙夜

movies.synopsis: Regular opening times do not apply as we accompany Sir David Attenborough on an after-hours journey around London’s Natural History Museum, one of his favourite haunts. The museum's various exhibits come to life, including dinosaurs, reptiles and creatures from the ice age.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 这部由爱丁保罗夫爷爷讲述的纪录片在伦敦自然历史博物馆拍摄，并使用最先进的CGI图像将博物馆中的几种已灭绝的动物带入生活，包括始祖鸟、恐鸟和哈斯特鹰等。

movies.title: Under the Sea 3D
movies.synopsis: Imagine a world of incredible color and beauty. Of crabs wearing jellyfish for hats. Of fish disguised as frogs, stones and shag carpets. Of a kaleidoscope of life dancing and weaving, floating and darting in an underwater wonderland. Now, go explore it! Howard Hall and his filmmaking team, who brought you Deep Sea and Into the Deep, take you into tropical waters alive with adventure: the Great Barrier Reef and other South Pacific realms. Narrated by Jim Carrey and featuring astonishing camerawork, this amazing film brings you face to fin with Nature's marvels, from the terrible grandeur (and terrible teeth) of a Great White to the comic antics of a lovestruck cuttlefish. Excitement and fun run deep Under the Sea!
movies.chineseSynopsis: 首部IMAX海下立体电影，为拍摄此片，水下摄影师携带重达近4吨的专用装备，下潜到了南澳大利亚和巴布亚新几内亚以及印度洋海域，历时110天、潜水350小时，首次成功采用IMAX 3D 摄影机在水下进行冒险拍摄。3D的视觉效果让观众与地球上最独特、最危险、最色彩斑斓的生物零距离接触，体验一次难得的深海旅行。

movies.title: Lady Bird
movies.synopsis: Lady Bird McPherson, a strong willed, deeply opinionated, artistic 17 year old comes of age in Sacramento. Her relationship with her mother and her upbringing are questioned and tested as she plans to head off to college.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 克里斯汀·“伯德小姐”·麦克弗森不断反抗却又与母亲惊人地相似——这位护士在丈夫失业后，正不知疲倦地支撑着家庭。影片背景设定在2002年经济剧变中的加利福尼亚州萨克拉门托，通过一段塑造人生的亲情关系、定义自我的信念，以及名为“家”的无可替代的美好，呈现了一部触动心灵的成长纪事。[A24]

movies.title: Naked

douban.chineseTitle: 白头神探：智斗灭世狂人

movies.tagline: The law's reach never stretched this far.
movies.synopsis: Only one man has the particular set of skills... to lead Police Squad and save the world: Lt. Frank Drebin Jr. Following in his father's footsteps, he must solve a murder case to prevent Police Squad from closure.
movies.chineseTagline: 法律的管辖范围从未延伸到如此之远。
movies.chineseSynopsis: 白头神探的儿子小弗兰克（连姆·尼森 Liam Neeson 饰）即将上演最无厘头的一次“营救”行动。

movies.title: Rose of Nevada
movies.synopsis: When a fishing boat, the Rose of Nevada, lost with all hands 30 years ago, mysteriously reappears in the old harbour of a forgotten Cornish village, for those who remember, it’s surely a sign. The boat must go out to sea again and maybe then the luck of the devastated village will turn. Young father Nick and enigmatic newcomer Liam join captain Murgey, and they head to sea. But when they return, satisfied with their haul, something is amiss – they’ve slipped back in time, and the villagers greet them as if they are the original crew.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 三十年前，“内华达之瑰”号消失于海上。如今，它回来了。两名为生计所迫的男子加入其船员队伍，再度起航，却很快发现自己被送回了过去，并被误认为原船员。

movies.title: Hackers
movies.countryOrigin: United States of America / United Kingdom
movies.synopsis: Along with his new friends, a teenager who was arrested by the US Secret Service and banned from using a computer for writing a computer virus discovers a plot by a nefarious hacker, but they must use their computer skills to find the evidence while being pursued by the Secret Service and the evil computer genius behind the virus.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 达德（约翰·李·米勒 Jonny Lee Miller 饰）是一名出色的天才黑客，曾经，股市因为11岁的他的小小恶作剧而差点崩盘，达德因此被剥夺了使用网络的权利，如今，已经成年的达德终于重新获得了这一权利，跃跃欲试的他摩拳擦掌，准备在网络上重新大展拳脚。凯特（安吉丽娜·朱莉 Angelina Jolie 饰）和乔伊（杰西·布拉德福特 Jesse Bradford 饰）都是如同达德一样的黑客，他们因为趣味相投而走到了一起成为了好友。普拉格（费舍·史蒂芬斯 Fisher Stevens 饰）曾经是一名技术高超的超级黑客，如今，被招安的他成为了一家大公司的系统安全专家。背地里，普拉格和黑恶势力勾结，谋取公司账户里的巨额财产，此外，他还发明了一种能令全球网络陷入瘫痪的可怕病毒。一次偶然中，达德一行人发现了普拉格的罪恶和阴谋，他们决定给利用自己的力量，阻止普拉格。 ©豆瓣

movies.title: Tangerine
movies.synopsis: It's Christmas Eve in Tinseltown and Sin-Dee is back on the block. Upon hearing that her pimp boyfriend hasn't been faithful during the 28 days she was locked up, the working girl and her best friend, Alexandra, embark on a mission to get to the bottom of the scandalous rumor. Their rip-roaring odyssey leads them through various subcultures of Los Angeles, including an Armenian family dealing with their own repercussions of infidelity.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 圣诞前夕的浮华城，辛迪回到了街头。当得知她的皮条客男友在她被拘留的28天内出轨，这位应召女郎与她的挚友亚历山德拉展开了一场探寻丑闻真相的行动。她们喧闹激烈的穿梭之旅，将她们带入了洛杉矶的各种亚文化圈，其中包括一个因出轨事件而陷入纠葛的亚美尼亚家庭。

comingSoonMovies.title: Avengers: Doomsday
comingSoonMovies.synopsis: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.
comingSoonMovies.chineseSynopsis: 来自三个截然不同宇宙的传奇英雄们，将被推向一场生死对决，并最终直面一股前所未见、足以撼动万物存亡的终极威胁。

comingSoonMovies.title: Ghost Soldier
comingSoonMovies.synopsis: Henry “Fitz” Fitzgerald has spent years living quietly off the grid, hiding from a past few people know anything about. But when a powerful foreign corporation moves into his hometown to seize his neighbors’ land for a massive payday, Fitz is forced to reveal who he really is: a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with experimental technology, lethal combat skills, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz wages a one-man war against an enemy that never saw him coming.
comingSoonMovies.chineseSynopsis: 亨利·“菲茨”·菲茨杰拉德，一个有着神秘过往的孤僻男子，在家乡过着与世隔绝的平静生活。然而，当一家实力雄厚的外国公司入侵他的社区，企图强占他和邻居们的土地以牟取暴利时，菲茨挺身而出——他实际上是一名退役特种部队士兵和先进武器研发专家。凭借着前所未见的武器、毕生接受的致命军事训练以及坚定不移的正义准则，菲茨成为了敌人始料未及的存在：一场他们无法取胜的孤胆英雄之战。

comingSoonMovies.title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
comingSoonMovies.synopsis: Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily cancelled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.
comingSoonMovies.chineseSynopsis: 哈利是个典型的纽约本地人，老派的街头混客，自上世纪80年代起就靠扒窃来的现金疏通关节、谋取生计。他手法老道，技艺不断精进，但时代正在抛弃哈利。现在是2025年，街头每日的“收获”是什么？是花里胡哨可追踪的智能手机。是塞满信用卡的无现金钱包。是装着加密货币和枪支的健身包

comingSoonMovies.title: Angel and the Badman
comingSoonMovies.synopsis: A wounded outlaw finds unexpected mercy in the care of a rancher's daughter. The hope of love pulls him toward a different life until the law, and his violent past, close in on his new home. Now he must choose the kind of man he'll become.
comingSoonMovies.chineseSynopsis: 翻拍自1947年同名西部电影。亡命枪手奎特·埃文斯身负枪伤，倒在一位牧场主的土地上，原以为自己必死无疑，却意外得到宽恕。牧场主的女儿佩妮给了他摆脱暴力、重新生活的机会。然而，随着警长步步逼近，亡命帮派也威胁要烧毁牧场，奎特必须决定自己究竟要成为怎样的人。

comingSoonMovies.title: Dune: Part Three
comingSoonMovies.countryOrigin: United States of America / United Arab Emirates
comingSoonMovies.synopsis: Nearly two decades after he seized control of the Imperium, Paul Atreides is now a ruthless Emperor, and must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.
comingSoonMovies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自弗兰克·赫伯特的科幻小说《沙丘2：沙丘救世主》。保罗·厄崔迪夺取帝国统治权近二十年后，成为冷酷的皇帝。面对旧盟友回归、新威胁浮现与暗中背叛，保罗深陷一场阴谋，并必须直面权力的代价与所爱之人的命运。

comingSoonMovies.title: Bitter Christmas
comingSoonMovies.synopsis: During a long December holiday weekend, a woman, whose mother has recently died, throws herself into work as a form of escape. Her relentless pace is interrupted when a panic attack forces her to take a break.
comingSoonMovies.chineseSynopsis: 广告总监埃尔莎在母亲于12月去世后，用工作麻痹自己以应对伤痛。一次惊恐发作迫使她停下脚步，她决定与好友帕特里夏前往兰萨罗特岛旅行。两位女性的故事与一位编剧兼电影导演的经历平行展开，探讨了生活与虚构如何密不可分地交织，有时甚至令人痛苦地纠缠。

comingSoonMovies.title: The Uprising
comingSoonMovies.synopsis: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.
comingSoonMovies.chineseSynopsis: 在中世纪的英格兰，一位无畏的勇士召集平民发动了一场激烈的起义，反抗国王理查德二世的高压统治。随着国家陷入混乱，他的起义军与王室军队展开了一场绝望的自由之战。

comingSoonMovies.title: Lilo & Scratch
comingSoonMovies.synopsis: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found, but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.
comingSoonMovies.chineseSynopsis: 故事设定在2002年原作之后：史迪奇终于在新家庭中过上了幸福安稳的日子，直到莉萝带回家一位新成员——一只粉色的外星小猫喵喵琦。这位新成员捣乱成性、光芒四射，无孔不入地渗透进史迪奇的生活，把他的整个世界搅了个天翻地覆。

comingSoonMovies.synopsis: Interpol agent Khalid Al-Azzazi joins forces with Ghali Abu Dawood from the 7 Dogs crime syndicate to fight drug trafficking.
comingSoonMovies.chineseSynopsis: 国际刑警精英特工哈立德（艾哈迈德·埃兹 饰）成功逮捕了国际神秘犯罪集团“七犬（7 Dogs）”的高层头目加利（卡里姆·阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹 饰）。一年后，该集团再次抬头，并开始在跨国市场大肆分销一种名为“粉红女郎（Pink Lady）”的致命新型合成毒品。由于局势失控，哈立德被迫与被囚禁的加利达成一项极具风险的不信任合作，依靠加利对集团内部的了解来瓦解这个庞大的网络。两人在多名国际特工的协助下，辗转于沙特利雅得、上海、孟买、拉斯维加斯等多个国际大都市，在充满背叛、爆炸与暗杀的险境中与欧洲毒枭朱莉娅（莫妮卡·贝鲁奇 饰）及其他幕后势力展开殊死搏斗。

comingSoonMovies.title: Cry Me a Sad River
comingSoonMovies.synopsis: Qi Ming is a handsome boy and he is also a top student at school, but Yi Yao is a so-called bitch on everyone’s lips. Qi and Yi grew up together and they have been maintaining a good relationship. However, everything is interrupted and changed by Tang Xiaomi. Rumors have become a sharp weapon to destroy people. Yi Yao's life falls into darkness, and she suffers all kinds of cruel bullying at school.
comingSoonMovies.chineseSynopsis: 多组校园欺凌事件，打破了5位主角本应该美好的青春校园生活。齐铭（赵英博 饰）清俊帅气，是人人称颂的优等生，而易遥（任敏 饰）却是大家口中的“赔钱货”。两人一同长大，感情很好。而这一切，在转学生唐小米（朱丹妮 饰）出现之后发生了翻天覆地的变化。流言成了毁人利器，处处对易瑶进行刁难，易遥的生活开始陷入黑暗，遭受各类残酷欺凌。顾森西（辛云来 饰）教会易瑶对校园暴力进行反击，他的出现给了易遥一丝曙光。可阴差阳错，顾森湘（章若楠 饰）的意外却将她再度推入黑暗。当受害者变成施暴者，当看客变成助推，在这一场名为“玩笑”的闹剧中，没有旁观者，只有施暴者……

comingSoonMovies.synopsis: In the ‘90s in Taiwan, two students share one desk at a high school divided into day and night classes. It is a story of love, friendship, disappointments, and ultimate growth bolstered by a compelling cast of up-and-coming Taiwanese acting talents.
comingSoonMovies.chineseSynopsis: 高中联考失手的小爱被妈妈安排升读名校「一女中」的夜校部，但即使与日校生共享课室和书桌，成绩上的差距却总让小爱心存距离感，自卑感油然而生。幸好共享书桌的「桌友」敏敏没有因此嫌弃，两人更成为好友，甚至一同喜欢上隔壁学校的资优男生卢克。为了方便走堂，两人经常互换校服，但小爱渐渐舍不得日校生的制服光环，更使用冒牌的一女中身份，瞒着敏敏接近卢克，巨大的谎言坑洞最终变得一发不可收拾。《最乖巧的杀人犯》导演庄景燊延续台湾校园电影浪潮，由新生代演员主演，带领观众重修青春的成长课。

comingSoonMovies.title: 24 Flavors
comingSoonMovies.synopsis: After years abroad, April returns to her homeland, discovering her divorced parents rekindling old ties. Memories of her extreme self-harm resurface as she grapples with her father's infidelity. Facing the impending demolition of the tea shop, April must decide between taking her mother Qiaozhen abroad or supporting her desire to continue the business. Struggling Yongtang silently raises funds for Qiaozhen's shop reopening, inadvertently falling into a scam. April also encounters her resilient half-sister Xiaojing. Amidst the challenges, she begins to reclaim the life, time, and self-reflection she had long avoided.
comingSoonMovies.chineseSynopsis: 出国多年后回到故土的四月（袁澧林 饰），发现早已离异的父母重拾旧好，年少时她以极端自虐的方式挽留出轨父亲（钟镇涛 饰）的记忆再度浮现。凉茶铺正面临拆迁，四月要带巧珍（张艾嘉 饰）出国生活，巧珍却希望继续经营凉茶铺。重回家庭的落魄永堂默默为巧珍筹措重开凉茶铺的资金，拼尽全力却误中骗局。一团乱麻时，四月又遇野蛮生长、同父异母的妹妹小景。她将过去逃避的生活、时间以及自省一点点拾起。

comingSoonMovies.chineseSynopsis: 暗恋这件事，偷偷藏不住。  　　桑稚青春里最隐秘的少女心事，是喜欢上哥哥桑延的大学室友段嘉许。这份因为年龄差距不敢言说的青涩暗恋，被小桑稚笨拙地藏了起来，不敢让任何人发现。  　　几年后再度重逢，桑稚长大成为明媚阳光的模样，而段嘉许也在相处中因她身上的光芒而心动。曾经悄无声息的喜欢，终于变成了彼此心照不宣的悸动……
